featured_reviews.name: Dhanashree Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience.
I ordered a chicken frankie for ₹60, but what I received was nothing more than a maida chapati with a thin layer of omelette. The so-called “chicken filling” was basically chicken gravy poured inside, with a few random pieces taken straight from the gravy—no proper stuffing, no flavour, no effort.
It honestly did not feel like a frankie at all. The taste was poor, the texture was messy, and overall it felt extremely cheap and careless. Even for ₹60, this was not worth it. Eating this felt like a waste of time and money.
Would not recommend this place if you’re expecting a proper chicken frankie or even basic quality.

featured_reviews.name: Soniii
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I visited Happy Sips and Bites with my friend, and it turned out to be a really nice experience.
The interior is amazing – very aesthetic, cozy, and beautifully designed. The vibes are super chill, perfect for relaxing and spending quality time with friends. You can easily sit for a long time and enjoy conversations.
We ordered hot coffee, white sauce pasta, cheese grilled sandwich, and Margherita pizza. The food was good, and honestly, as per the price, the taste was quite satisfying. If we compare with the pricing, the food is definitely worth it.
One thing I would specially mention – visiting in the evening is a must. Because of the lights and ambiance, the interior looks even more beautiful and gives a very warm feel.
However, the service was a bit slow, and I feel they need more staff to manage orders better, especially during busy hours.
Overall, the best part of this place is its interior and ambiance. It’s a great place to chill, click pictures, and spend quality time with friends.

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha N
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this cafe with a friend and was disappointed with our experience. We ordered the Paneer Makhani Cheese Grill Sandwich, Tandoori Pizza, and Cheese Balls.

Upon arrival, we were told we could sit inside and were directed to scan the QR code on the table for the menu instead we requested a hardcopy. However, we later discovered that each item on the hardcopy menu had an additional ₹20 charge due to AC, which wasn't disclosed during ordering.

Now, let's come to the food.
The size of the grilled sandwich was too small, not like your average sandwich bread slices, here you get four pieces of a single sandwich also the stuffing is so minimal .
For the cheese balls, you will get two cheese balls made of BREAD with minimal cheese inside; let me tell you, cheese balls are typically made with potatoes as the primary ingredient, not bread.
We ordered tandoori pizza after their recommendations, and there was no tandoori visual appeal although the quantity of cheese in pizza was decent.
The appearance and ambiance are good and picture worthy, the same as the previous cafe before this cafe was opened.

I'm attaching pictures of the food for your reference.

Suggestions for improvement:
- Clearly communicate pricing differences between QR code and hardcopy menus.
- Enhance food portion sizes and quality
- Consider revising recipes to meet customer expectations

featured_reviews.name: Raviraj Samant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Found that this place had good reviews on Zomato but could not find even a single post about it on Google Maps. Being curious, went there to check out their menu. It's located a bit off from its placement on the map. The printed menu is old with less nuber of food items.

We had 3 refreshments. First one was 'Kiwi Mojito' which tasted great! However it being non-alcoholic, the quantity seemed less (even more so with the ice). You will finish this off within a minute or two just when the taste hits you. Rating: Taste: 5/5, Value for money: 3/5.

Next was 'Cold Coffee', which in isolation would taste good but after tasting mojito (our mistake) it tasted good but not great! The coffee sort of tasted like melted biscuit. Would like to taste more "coffee" in it. Taste: 3.5/5 VFM: 4.5/5.

Lastly we ordered the '5 Star' which as expected does not look like the one in promotional pictures but the taste of different layers was good. We could find 3 layers + ice cream. The quantity and taste here was balanced (But still Kiwi Mojito was the best amongst the three) Taste: 4.5/5, VFM: 4.5/5.

They also serve other variety of foodstuff which we haven't tried yet but that's for the next time. The serve time is quick, recommendations are accepted, seating is good. Had a great time here!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hi Raviraj thank for your review, we accept your feedback with open heart and will try to serve you more fusion and delicious food on your next visit.
